summary: Cylinder stock gains an Axis enumeration property (X/Y/Z, default Z) exposed as a combo box in the Job task panel's Stock tab; auto-sized cylinder stock now derives radius, height and placement from the chosen axis, and the CreateCylinder scripting helper takes an axis argument.

pages.reason: Gui/Resources/panels/PathEdit.ui: stockCreateCylinder frame gains an 'Axis' QComboBox above Radius/Height; Path/Main/Stock.py: StockCreateCylinder adds App::PropertyEnumeration 'Axis' (X, Y, Z; default Z) and CreateCylinder() gains an axis parameter that changes auto-sizing (height along chosen axis, radius from the other two extents) and placement (origin at the min of the chosen axis, centred on the other two).
